title: The closer we get to the end… the more truth is rejected.
paragraphs: The closer we get to the end… the more truth is rejected.

“For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine…”
— 2 Timothy 4:3
We are watching this happen in real time.

People no longer ask:
“Is this true?”

They ask:
“Does this make me feel comfortable?”

Truth confronts sin.
Truth exposes deception.
Truth demands repentance.
And because of that… truth becomes hated.

But the rejection of truth is not a surprise to God.
It was a sign that the time would come.

The world may reject it.
But the watchman must still proclaim it.
The question is not whether truth will be hated.
Will you still stand for it?
Do you think the world today is rejecting biblical truth more than ever before?
